# The Infatuation

> > The Infatuation is a restaurant discovery and review platform providing curated dining guides and honest reviews across major cities worldwide.

Founded by food critics and writers, The Infatuation offers neighborhood-specific restaurant recommendations, comprehensive city guides, and detailed reviews spanning casual eateries to fine dining establishments. The platform covers major metropolitan areas including New York, San Francisco, Miami, London, Seattle, Austin, Portland, and international destinations.

## Key Topics

- Restaurant reviews
- Dining guides
- New restaurant openings
- Neighborhood dining
- Casual dining
- New York restaurants
- San Francisco restaurants
- Miami restaurants
- London restaurants
- Italian restaurants
- Sushi restaurants
- Coffee shops
- Breakfast & brunch spots
- Financial District dining
- Brickell dining

## City & Neighborhood Dining Guides

- [The 9 Best Restaurants In Canary Wharf - London](https://www.theinfatuation.com/london/guides/best-restaurants-canary-wharf): Guide to top 9 dining spots in London's Canary Wharf business district
- [The Best Restaurants Around Crouch End - London](https://www.theinfatuation.com/london/guides/best-restaurants-food-coffee-drink-crouch-end): Guide to best restaurants in north London's Crouch End neighborhood
- [The Best Restaurants In Healdsburg](https://www.theinfatuation.com/healdsburg/guides/best-restaurants-healdsburg): Guide to best restaurants in Healdsburg wine country, Sonoma County
